accepted_services.name: Emmaus Åland – lokalt varubistånd med gåvokort
accepted_services.organizer: Emmaus Åland r.f.; referrals and needs assessment by professional social workers and partner agencies
coverage_verified: All 16 Åland municipalities as a regional programme; individual access is referral-based
accepted_services.location: Voucher redemption at Emmaus stores: Strandgatan 20, Mariehamn; Skogshyddsvägen 7, Norrböle, Mariehamn; Godbyvägen 1424, Godby, Finström; Svinryggen, Hammarlandsvägen 817, Jomala.
accepted_services.regular_time: Ongoing programme during 2026; no separate walk-in aid hours. Vouchers are redeemed during store opening hours: Strandgatan Mon–Fri 10–19, Thu 10–20, Sat 10–17, Sun 11–15; Norrböle Mon–Fri 10–18, Thu 10–19, Sat 10–16, Sun 11–15; Godby Mon–Fri 10–18, Sat 11–16; Svinryggen Mon–Fri 12–18, Sat 10–15.
accepted_services.free_and_conditions: Free goods assistance for private individuals on Åland living in difficult financial circumstances. A professional social worker assesses the overall situation. The referring agency issues a gift card usable in Emmaus stores; referrals may come from KST, parishes, ÅHS, Rädda Barnen and other organisations. Emmaus also issues vouchers to new refugee families and other groups needing temporary support. No direct self-application to the voucher programme is described.
accepted_services.contact: Emmaus central/store contact +358 18 16069. City store +358 18 16069; Norrböle +358 18 17643; Godby +358 457 344 3989; Svinryggen +358 457 348 4670. Website: emmaus.ax.

accepted_services.name: Kommunernas socialtjänst (KST) – grundläggande, kompletterande och förebyggande utkomststöd
accepted_services.location: KST, Skarpansvägen 30, Mariehamn; applications and service cover all Åland municipalities.
accepted_services.regular_time: Ongoing statutory application service; apply by KST e-service or paper application. No fixed walk-in schedule confirmed in the current 2026 source.
accepted_services.free_and_conditions: Financial assistance for individuals and families whose income and assets do not cover necessary expenses. Last-resort support: primary benefits such as housing benefit, unemployment benefits, pensions or sickness benefits must normally be applied for first. Support can cover basic living costs and necessary housing expenses including rent-related costs, household electricity and home insurance. It is a benefit, not a paid service; individual assessment applies.
accepted_services.contact: KST switchboard 018 532 800; socialkansliet@kst.ax; Skarpansvägen 30, Mariehamn. Exact current reception/phone hours need a fresh confirmation.

accepted_services.name: Ålands diakonifond
accepted_services.organizer: Jomala församling administers the island-wide fund together with the local parishes
coverage_verified: All 16 Åland municipalities through the seven parish areas
accepted_services.location: Applications are made through the local parish diaconal worker; there is no single client-facing collection point.
accepted_services.regular_time: Ongoing; the local diaconal worker assesses the situation with the applicant. The diaconal team processes applications, normally in about two weeks. No fixed application hours; contact the local parish.
accepted_services.free_and_conditions: Grant funding used exclusively to help people in need on Åland. A private individual cannot apply directly to the fund: a parish diaconal worker assesses whether the parish can help from its own resources or submit an application to the fund. No fee or repayment requirement is stated.
accepted_services.contact: Jomala parish diaconia: Ann-Lis Biström 018 328 313; diaconia line 018 328 301. Other local parish contacts are listed on the official fund page.

accepted_services.name: Rädda Barnen på Åland – Barnfonden
coverage_verified: All 16 Åland municipalities; all are selectable in the current application form
accepted_services.location: Köpmansgatan 10, 22100 Mariehamn; applications can be submitted electronically or on paper.
accepted_services.regular_time: Applications are processed continuously during the year; the organisation aims to reply within one month. The office may be closed and no grants made during holidays and school breaks.
accepted_services.free_and_conditions: Free grant support for children aged 0–17 and their families in financial hardship or temporary crisis. Examples include hobby and leisure fees, hobby equipment, birthday celebrations and special experiences. Each application is assessed individually according to the child's needs and the fund's available resources; an application does not guarantee a grant. The fund generally does not replace goods or services that municipalities or the state are legally required to provide.

accepted_services.name: Ålands rättshjälps- och intressebevakningsbyrå – ekonomi- och skuldrådgivning
accepted_services.location: Torggatan 16 A, 22100 Mariehamn; service area explicitly lists all 16 municipalities.
accepted_services.regular_time: Weekdays. Official service location hours 08:00–16:15; client contact/booking by phone weekdays 09:00–11:00 and 13:00–15:00.
accepted_services.free_and_conditions: Free and confidential financial and debt counselling. Helps with everyday budgeting, spending plans, debt questions and over-indebtedness. No income threshold stated for this counselling service.

accepted_services.name: Avgiftsfri avlösning under närståendevårdares och anhörigvårdares lagstadgade ledighet
accepted_services.organizer: Municipalities and KST, depending on the care recipient's service responsibility
coverage_verified: All 16 Åland municipalities under the Åland client-fee legislation
accepted_services.location: Arranged individually by the municipality or KST; the service form and location are recorded in the care and service plan.
accepted_services.regular_time: Planned in advance with the responsible social/elder-care official. A caregiver continuously bound to care day and night or every day is entitled to at least five days of leave per month; the replacement care is arranged for the leave period.
accepted_services.free_and_conditions: The replacement services provided during statutory caregiver leave are free of charge under the amended Åland Client Fee Act effective 1.1.2024. This is not general free home help: it applies only to services that replace the caregiver's care during approved statutory leave. The service form is individually arranged.
accepted_services.contact: Start with the elder-care/social-services office in the home municipality; KST switchboard 018 532 800 for KST services. Local implementation confirmed on Brändö (Niklas Feiring 040 768 7505) and Geta (municipal supervisor 018 49340). Jomala elder-care office 018 329 141.

accepted_services.name: Brändö kommun – ekonomiskt understöd för anpassningsåtgärder i hemmet
accepted_services.location: Permanent home in Brändö; application to the municipal elderly-care office, Nottholmsvägen 71 A, 22940 Åva.
accepted_services.regular_time: Applications can be submitted continuously during the year. The application must be approved before the adaptation work begins; a home visit is arranged if the eligibility criteria are met.
accepted_services.free_and_conditions: Non-repayable, needs-tested grant for small home adaptations that enable an age pensioner aged 65+ to remain at home. Applicant must be permanently resident in Brändö and meet household income limits; assets excluding the home must not exceed €20,000. Grant covers up to 80% of approved costs, maximum €2,000 per dwelling; full approved costs may exceptionally be covered for social/economic reasons. Other state/KST/Åland grants are primary.
accepted_services.contact: Elder-care manager Niklas Feiring, 040 768 7505; Nottholmsvägen 71 A, Åva. Arrange a visit in advance.
